## Change

**PR244's common-delivery-frame retiming on the p = 10 word**, as the concave-descent stage of [#287](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/287) (`descent_transform.py`, shape-generalized from h = 24 to h = 20, m = 100, h copied centres of rank h − 2 with 3v/h scatter reads). The p = 10 word has no frame retiming; local descent on Σ r·ln(m/r) finds the same pattern at this size: each of the **480 unborrowed source-pair mixes** runs at its rank-18 common delivery frame, so per pair the paid children of ranks 1, 1, 16, 18 become 17, 17, 2. Local histogram delta {1: −960, 2: +480, 16: −480, 17: +960, 18: −480}; 480 local recursive calls disappear at unchanged rank mass 181,050 (five-stage calls 248,360 → 245,960); no new frames. The transform rebuilds every MOVE, checks the byte-identical scalar/COPY projection, nested chains, fixed endpoints, COPY lifetimes, nondegenerate endpoint bases, both reflected ledgers and the exact integer source span of every non-target operand; `raw_ledger.rebind_descent` recounts the profile. Literal stock 663,030 → 660,630; all changed counts re-pinned in `word-pins.json` by #315's `discovery/repin.py`; `verify.py` runs strict.
